in various research projects at Centre of Excellence for Wildlife & Conservation Studies,
Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University, Junagadh, Gujarat, India is scheduled on October 28,
2026 at 10:30 AM at the Office of the Chief Conservator of Forests, Marine National Park,
Jamnagar, Gujarat. The details of the posts such as qualifications, experience, fellowships etc
are given below:

Interested and eligible candidates MUST complete the registration form for walk-in
interview at least 24 hours before the scheduled interview. Candidate may walk in with
their CV, Application form (as per the given format) and all the relevant original
documents with one set of photocopies at the following address.
Scan QR for Registration:
https://forms.gle/UAZxakECYye1hoAM7
Reporting Time: 10:00 am
Venue: Office of the Chief Conservator of Forests,
Marine national park
'Van sankul', Ganjiwada, Forest colony campus
Near nagnath gate, Indira marg,
Jamnagar, Gujarat - 361005
(Location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/8u9kLsSfJp6rvP2f6 )
Note:
1. Candidates must fill out a separate application form and submit a separate set of
documents for each post applied for.
2. Candidates are requested to report at least 30 minutes before the scheduled interview
time for registration and document verification.
3. No Travel Allowance (TA) or Daily Allowance (DA) will be provided to candidates for
attending the interview.
4. The remuneration offered is fixed and consolidated. No additional allowances or
benefits will be admissible.
5. The positions are purely contractual and project-based. The appointment will be co-
terminus with the duration of the respective project and will be subject to the availability
of project funds and applicable terms and conditions.
For any queries, contact to wildlife@bknmu.edu.in
Bhakta Kavi Narsinh Mehta University
Centre of Excellence for Wildlife and Conservation Studies
